items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: And we used to, me and my brother used to pass there, and the man used to just dig in the pocket and give her two and three and five dollars. And say, your daddy saved me, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, well there's a lot of, there's a lot, two, I think. A lot of the folk remedies that people use. Yeah.

And that man, he used to lay around on Spruce Street, you know, on Spruce between Eagle and Monroe. And we used to, me and my brother used to pass there, and the man used to just dig in the pocket and give her two and three and five dollars. And say, your daddy saved me, you know. And man, dude, during that time, man, fifty cents to us was a lot of money. You know about two, three, five dollars, man. Yeah. You know? Yeah, man. And I learned that after he died, you know, he died when I was in the Navy, you know,…
